templates.description: Returns unapproved shopping carts. Filters by SupplierId.
templates.sql:
SELECT
  vsch.shop_cart_cre_dt AS CreateDate,
  vsci.shop_cart_itm_cre_uid AS CreatedBy,
  vsci.shop_cart_nbr AS ShoppingCartNumber,
  vsci.shop_cart_line_nbr AS Line,
  vsci.prd_dsc AS ItemDescription,
  vsca.aprvr_uid AS Approver,
  CASE vsca.src_sys_nm
    WHEN 'SBI-NBP' THEN
      CASE vsca.aprv_sts_cd
        WHEN 'I1129' THEN 'Approved'
        WHEN 'I1015' THEN 'Awaiting Approval'
        WHEN 'I1016' THEN 'Rejected'
        ELSE 'Review'
      END
    ELSE
      CASE vsca.aprv_sts_cd
        WHEN '3' THEN 'Approved'
        WHEN '1' THEN 'Waiting'
        WHEN '2' THEN 'Rejected'
        ELSE 'Review'
      END
  END AS Status,
  vsca.aprv_chn_seq_nbr AS ApproveSequence
FROM PROCUREMENT.v_shop_cart_aprvr vsca
INNER JOIN PROCUREMENT.v_shop_cart_itm vsci
  ON vsca.shop_cart_nbr = vsci.shop_cart_nbr
INNER JOIN PROCUREMENT.v_shop_cart_hdr vsch
  ON vsci.shop_cart_nbr = vsch.shop_cart_nbr
WHERE ('@SupplierId') = '99999999'
  AND (
       (vsca.src_sys_nm = 'SBI-NBP' AND vsca.aprv_sts_cd <> 'I1129')
    OR (vsca.src_sys_nm <> 'SBI-NBP' AND vsca.aprv_sts_cd <> '3')
  )
UNION ALL

  vsci.prd_dsc AS ItemDescription,
  vsca.aprvr_uid AS Approver,
  CASE vsca.src_sys_nm
    WHEN 'SBI-NBP' THEN

        WHEN 'I1129' THEN 'Approved'
        WHEN 'I1015' THEN 'Awaiting Approval'

        WHEN '1' THEN 'Waiting'

     ELSE
       (CASE
          WHEN vfsiel.purch_doc_line_nbr='*'

          ELSE vfsiel.purch_doc_line_nbr

  (CASE
     WHEN vfsiel.dr_cr_ind='S' THEN
       (CASE
          WHEN fin_doc_rvrs_nbr<>'*' THEN 'Reversed Debit'
          ELSE 'Debit'
        END)
     ELSE
       (CASE
          WHEN fin_doc_rvrs_nbr<>'*' THEN 'Reversed Credit'
          ELSE 'Credit'

     WHEN fin_doc_rvrs_nbr<>'*' THEN 'Not Paid'
     ELSE
       (CASE
          WHEN vfsih.pmt_bloc_cd<>'' THEN 'Blocked'
          ELSE
            (CASE
               WHEN vfsic.clr_doc_nbr='*' THEN 'Pending'
               ELSE
                 (CASE
                    WHEN vfsiel.purch_doc_line_nbr='*' THEN 'N/A'
                    ELSE 'Paid'
                  END)
             END)
        END)
   END) AS PaymentStatus,
  vfsic.clr_trns_cur_cd AS PmtCurrency,
  vfsic.paid_trns_amt AS PaidAmt,

  vfsiel.wbs_nbr AS WbsNbr,

    WHEN vfsiel.fin_doc_nbr IS NULL THEN ''
    ELSE vfsiel.fin_doc_nbr
  END AS SapPmtDoc

templates.description: Returns supplier details from v_supl using a partial match on the supplier name.
templates.sql:
SELECT
  supl_line_1_nm ||
    (CASE
       WHEN supl_line_2_nm IS NULL THEN ''
       ELSE supl_line_2_nm
     END) AS SupplierName,
  NULL AS SupplierId,
  CASE
    WHEN vs.supl_id IS NULL THEN ''
    ELSE vs.supl_id
  END AS LegacySupplierId,
  duns_dsply_nbr AS SupplierDunsNbr,
  NULL AS LifeCycle,
  addr_line_1_dsc AS SupplierAddress,
  city_nm AS City,
  rgn_cd AS RegionCode,
  CASE
    WHEN rgn_nm IS NULL THEN ''
    ELSE rgn_nm
  END AS RegionName,
  post_cd AS PostCode,
  ctry_cd AS CountryCode,
  ctry_nm AS CountryName,
  vs.tel_nbr AS SupplierPhoneNbr,
  vs.fax_nbr AS SupplierFaxNbr,
  vs.supl_id AS LegSuplId
FROM SUPPLIER.v_supl vs
LEFT JOIN SUPPLIER.v_dim_supl_hier vdsh
  ON vs.supl_id = vdsh.supl_id
WHERE supl_line_1_nm LIKE '%@SupplierName%';
